findings.issue: dir="auto" on translated chrome resolves LTR for Urdu strings beginning with Latin 'Guard' or {org}; Urdu reads out of order and left-aligned in the consent prompt and Settings section.
findings.replacement: Code fix: drop dir="auto" on translated chrome (inherit html dir) or bind dir to the locale direction (LocaleDirectionProvider); keep FSI/PDI around {org}. No catalogue change.
findings.disposition: reported to manager for coder; not a translation defect, not counted.
